268template<typename T>
269struct mpRange
270{
271 T min = 0;
272 T max = 0;
273
275 mpRange()
276 {
277 min = 0;
278 max = 0;
279 }
280
282 mpRange(T value1, T value2)
283 {
284 if (value1 < value2)
285 {
286 min = value1;
287 max = value2;
288 }
289 else
290 {
291 min = value2;
292 max = value1;
293 }
294 }
295
297 void Set(T value_)
298 {
299 min = value_;
300 max = value_;
301 }
302
304 void Set(T min_, T max_)
305 {
306 min = min_;
307 max = max_;
308 }
309
311 void SetMin(T min_)
312 {
313 min = min_;
314 if (max < min)
315 max = min;
316 }
317
319 void SetMax(T max_)
320 {
321 max = max_;
322 if (min > max)
323 min = max;
324 }
325
327 void Assign(T value1, T value2)
328 {
329 if (value1 < value2)
330 {
331 min = value1;
332 max = value2;
333 }
334 else
335 {
336 min = value2;
337 max = value1;
338 }
339 }
340
342 bool IsSet() const
343 {
344 return ((min != 0) || (max != 0));
345 }
346
351 void Update(T value)
352 {
353 if (value < min)
354 min = value;
355 else
356 if (value > max)
357 max = value;
358 }
359
363 void Update(T min_, T max_)
364 {
365 if (min_ < min)
366 min = min_;
367 if (max_ > max)
368 max = max_;
369 }
370
373 void Update(mpRange range)
374 {
375 if (range.min < min)
376 min = range.min;
377 if (range.max > max)
378 max = range.max;
379 }
380
382 void Check(void)
383 {
384 if (min == max)
385 {
386 if (max > 0)
387 min = 0;
388 else
389 max = 0;
390 }
391 }
392
394 T Length(void) const
395 {
396 return max - min;
397 }
398
400 T GetCenter(void) const
401 {
402 return (min + max) / 2;
403 }
404
406 T GetMaxAbs(void) const
407 {
408 return std::max(fabs(min), fabs(max));
409 }
410
412 void ToLog(void)
413 {
414 min = (min > 0) ? log10(min) : 0;
415 max = (max > 0) ? log10(max) : 0;
416 }
417
419 bool PointIsInside(T point) const
420 {
421 return ((point >= min) && (point <= max));
422 }
423
424 #if (defined(__cplusplus) && (__cplusplus > 201703L)) // C++20 or newer
425 bool operator==(const mpRange&) const = default;
426 #else
428 bool operator==(const mpRange &other) const
429 {
430 return (min == other.min) && (max == other.max);
431 }
433 bool operator!=(const mpRange& other) const
434 {
435 return !(*this == other);
436 }
437 #endif
438};

445struct [[deprecated("Deprecated! No longer used as X and Y are now separated")]] mpFloatRect
446{
447 mpRange<double> x;
448 std::vector<mpRange<double>> y;
449
456 mpFloatRect(mpWindow& w);
457
459 mpFloatRect() = delete;
460
467 bool PointIsInside(const double px, const double py, const size_t yAxisID = 0) const {
468 if (yAxisID < y.size())
469 {
470 if( (px < x.min || px > x.max) ||
471 (py < y[yAxisID].min || py > y[yAxisID].max))
472 {
473 return false;
474 }
475 }
476 else
477 {
478 return false;
479 }
480
481 return true;
482 }
483
490 void UpdateBoundingBoxToInclude(const double px, const double py, const size_t yAxisID = 0) {
491 assert(yAxisID < y.size());
492 if (yAxisID < y.size())
493 {
494 if (px < x.min ) x.min = px;
495 else if (px > x.max ) x.max = px;
496 if (py < y[yAxisID].min ) y[yAxisID].min = py;
497 else if (py > y[yAxisID].max ) y[yAxisID].max = py;
498 }
499 }
500
507 void InitializeBoundingBox(const double px, const double py, const size_t yAxisID = 0) {
508 assert(yAxisID < y.size());
509 if (yAxisID < y.size())
510 {
511 x.min = x.max = px;
512 y[yAxisID].min = y[yAxisID].max = py;
513 }
514 }
516 bool IsNotSet(mpWindow& w) const { const mpFloatRect def(w); return *this==def; }
518#if (defined(__cplusplus) && (__cplusplus > 201703L)) // C++ > C++17 (MSVC requires <AdditionalOptions>/Zc:__cplusplus</AdditionalOptions>
519 bool operator==(const mpFloatRect&) const = default;
520#else
521 // We compare with an epsilon precision
522 // NOTE: should be unnecessary as we are looking for any changes; normally this will be an exact match or a real change...
523 bool operator==(const mpFloatRect& rect) const
524 {
525 auto Same = [](const double a, const double b) {
526 return std::fabs(a - b) < MP_EPSILON;
527 };
528
529 // Compare scalar members
530 if (!Same(x.min, rect.x.min) || !Same(x.max, rect.x.max))
531 {
532 return false;
533 }
534
535 // Compare vector sizes
536 if (y.size() != rect.y.size())
537 {
538 return false;
539 }
540
541 // Compare each Y boundary
542 for (size_t i = 0; i < y.size(); ++i)
543 {
544 if (!Same(y[i].min, rect.y[i].min) ||
545 !Same(y[i].max, rect.y[i].max) )
546 {
547 return false;
548 }
549 }
550
551 return true;
552 }
553#endif
554};

561struct mpFloatRectSimple
562{
563 mpRange<double> x;
564 mpRange<double> y;
565
571 mpFloatRectSimple(const mpRange<double> x_, const mpRange<double> y_) : x(x_), y(y_) { };
572
578 bool PointIsInside(const double px, const double py) const {
579 return x.PointIsInside(px) && y.PointIsInside(py);
580 }
581
587 void UpdateBoundingBoxToInclude(const double px, const double py)
588 {
589 x.Update(px);
590 y.Update(py);
591 }
592
597 void InitializeBoundingBox(const double px, const double py)
598 {
599 x.Set(px, px);
600 y.Set(py, py);
601 }
602};

2462class mpFXGeneric: public mpFX
2463{
2464 public:
2469 mpFXGeneric(const wxString &name = wxT("Generic FX function"), const int flags = mpALIGN_LEFT, const unsigned int yAxisID = 0) :
2470 mpFX(name, flags, yAxisID)
2471 {
2472 const wxPen FXpen(*wxBLUE, 1, wxPENSTYLE_SOLID);
2473 SetDrawOutsideMargins(false);
2474 SetContinuity(true);
2475 SetPen(FXpen);
2476 SetStep(8); // Draw one point over eight
2477 }
2478
2483 double GetY(const double x) override
2484 {
2485 double y;
2486 try
2487 {
2488 y = ComputeY(x);
2489 }
2490 catch (...)
2491 {
2492 y = 0;
2493 }
2494 m_rangeY.Update(y);
2495 return y;
2496 }
2497
2502 double GetMinY() override
2503 {
2504 return m_rangeY.min;
2505 }
2506
2511 double GetMaxY() override
2512 {
2513 return m_rangeY.max;
2514 }
2515
2516 protected:
2517 mpRange<double> m_rangeY;
2518
2524 virtual double ComputeY(double x) = 0;
2525
2526 private:
2527 DECLARE_DYNAMIC_CLASS_MATHPLOT(mpFXGeneric);
2528};
2529
2534class mpGaussian: public mpFXGeneric
2535{
2536 public:
2542 mpGaussian(const double mu, const double sigma) :
2543 mpFXGeneric(wxT("Gaussian"), mpALIGN_LEFT)
2544 {
2545 m_mu = mu;
2546 m_sigma = sigma;
2547 m_variance = sigma * sigma;
2548 m_const = 1.0 / sqrt(2.0 * M_PI * m_variance);
2549 }
2550
2551 protected:
2552 double m_mu;
2553 double m_sigma;
2554 double m_variance;
2555 double m_const;
2556
2557 double ComputeY(const double x) override
2558 {
2559 return m_const * exp(-(x - m_mu) * (x - m_mu) / (2.0 * m_variance));
2560 }
2561
2562 private:
2563 DECLARE_DYNAMIC_CLASS_MATHPLOT(mpGaussian);
2564};
2565
2570class mpNormal: public mpFXGeneric
2571{
2572 public:
2578 mpNormal(const double mu, const double sigma) :
2579 mpFXGeneric(wxT("Normal"), mpALIGN_LEFT)
2580 {
2581 m_mu = mu;
2582 m_sigma = sigma;
2583 m_variance = sigma * sigma;
2584 m_const = 1.0 / (m_variance * sqrt(2.0 * M_PI));
2585 }
2586
2587 protected:
2588 double m_mu;
2589 double m_sigma;
2590 double m_variance;
2591 double m_const;
2592
2593 double ComputeY(const double x) override
2594 {
2595 if (x < 0)
2596 return 0.0;
2597 else
2598 {
2599 const double tmp = log(x) - m_mu;
2600 return m_const * exp(-tmp * tmp / (2.0 * m_variance)) / x;
2601 }
2602 }
2603
2604 private:
2605 DECLARE_DYNAMIC_CLASS_MATHPLOT(mpNormal);
2606};

3332struct mpAxisData
3333{
3334 mpScale* axis = nullptr;
3335 double scale = 1.0;

3337 mpRange<double> bound;
3338 mpRange<double> desired;
3339 mpRange<double> lastDesired;

3341 // Note: we don't use the default operator since we don't want to compare axis pointers
3343 bool operator==(const mpAxisData& other) const
3344 {
3345 return /*(axis == other.axis) && */ (scale == other.scale) && (pos == other.pos) &&
3346 (bound == other.bound) && (desired == other.desired);
3347 }
3348};

4031 void UpdateDesiredBoundingBox(const mpAxisUpdate update)
4032 {
4033 // Change on X axis
4034 if (update & uXAxis)
4035 {
4036 m_AxisDataX.desired.Set(m_AxisDataX.pos + (m_margin.left / m_AxisDataX.scale),
4037 m_AxisDataX.pos + ((m_margin.left + m_plotWidth) / m_AxisDataX.scale));
4038 }
4039
4040 // Change on Y axis
4041 if (update & uYAxis)
4042 {
4043 for (auto& [m_yID, m_yData] : m_AxisDataYList)
4044 {
4045 m_yData.desired.Set(m_yData.pos - ((m_margin.top + m_plotHeight) / m_yData.scale),
4046 m_yData.pos - (m_margin.top / m_yData.scale));
4047 }
4048 }
4049 }

4061 else
4062 return mpFloatRectSimple(m_AxisDataX.bound, m_AxisDataYList[yAxisID].bound);

5342typedef enum __mp_Colour
5343{
5344 mpBlue,

5354
5359class WXDLLIMPEXP_MATHPLOT wxIndexColour: public wxColour
5360{
5361 public:
5366 wxIndexColour(const unsigned int id)
5367 {
5368#ifdef _WIN32
5369 auto GetRandomColor = []() {
5370 return (rand() * 255) / RAND_MAX;
5371 };
5372#else
5373 auto GetRandomColor = []() {
5374 return (random() * 255) / RAND_MAX;
5375 };
5376#endif
5377 switch (id)
5378 {
5379 case 0:
5380 this->Set(0, 0, 255);
5381 break; // Blue
5382 case 1:
5383 this->Set(255, 0, 0);
5384 break; // Red
5385 case 2:
5386 this->Set(0, 128, 0);
5387 break; // Green
5388 case 3:
5389 this->Set(128, 0, 128);
5390 break; // Purple
5391 case 4:
5392 this->Set(255, 255, 0);
5393 break; // Yellow
5394 case 5:
5395 this->Set(255, 0, 255);
5396 break; // Fuchsia
5397 case 6:
5398 this->Set(0, 255, 0);
5399 break; // Lime
5400 case 7:
5401 this->Set(0, 255, 255);
5402 break; // Aqua/Cyan
5403 case 8:
5404 this->Set(128, 128, 0);
5405 break; // Olive
5406 default:
5407 this->Set((ChannelType) (GetRandomColor()), (ChannelType) (GetRandomColor()), (ChannelType) (GetRandomColor()));
5408 }
5409 }
5410};
